messages:
Aisha (Support): Hey @Dave — saw your support ticket about the embeddings usage spike and the billing jump. Can you paste the dashboard screenshot or a time window? Also your project id?

Dave (Customer): here's a screenshot link: https://example.com/screen.png
Units in the legend say "vectors" but the tooltip shows token counts. Total looks ~2x what we expect for Mar 15-16.

Aisha (Support): Yikes. Carla from analytics can you take a quick look? @Carla (Analytics)

Carla (Analytics): Looking. I see a mapping change landed in the rollup job last week that added a "unit_label" field but the hourly rollup still joins on the old "units" column. Possibility: some sources emit both and we're double-aggregating.

Ben (Eng): On ingestion we also had a replay that ran yesterday. If the replay re-ingested events without dedupe keys, the rollups would count them twice. Checking replay logs now.

ingest-bot: ALERT: replay-job-2026-03-16T18:02 completed, reprocessed 1,200,324 embedding events across 3 partitions.

Dave (Customer): That matches the timing of our billing spike. Can you confirm whether those reprocessed events were deduped before aggregation?

Carla (Analytics): Quick repro for internal triage:
1) Run this query to get raw events: `SELECT request_id, unit_type, created_at FROM embeddings_events WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-15' AND project_id = 'proj_abc'` 
2) Count raw rows vs unique request_id: `SELECT COUNT(*) as raw_count, COUNT(DISTINCT request_id) as dedup_count FROM embeddings_events ...`
I ran it and raw_count = 246,000; dedup_count = 123,000. So duplicates present.

Carla (Analytics): Root cause appears twofold: (a) the replay re-inserted events with new event_ids but same request_id, and (b) the dashboard rollup uses a legacy vector-count field plus the new unit_label rollup, summing both when unit_label is ambiguous.

Ben (Eng): I've pinned the ingestion service logs. We missed honoring `replay_marker` dedupe in the 1.4.2 hotpatch. Pushing a fix to prefer `request_id` dedupe and to add a temporary filter to the rollup pipeline.

Ops OnCall: Paused replay-job-2026-03-16T18:02. Created internal incident INC-8231. :white_check_mark:

Aisha (Support): Short-term plan: Carla will run a backfill that dedupes hourly rollups by request_id and unit_label; Ben will deploy the dedupe fix to ingestion; Ops paused the replay. We'll then validate billing delta and issue a customer credit if needed. ETA for backfill?

Carla (Analytics): Backfill job queued, estimate 2.5 hours to process the affected window and rebuild the hourly rollups. I'll post results and a before/after chart.

Ben (Eng): Hotfix deployed to canary (10%). No errors in logs in last 10m. Rolling to 100% now. Will monitor token/vector metrics.

Dave (Customer): Thanks — please escalate billing credit. This caused a customer-facing alarm.

Aisha (Support): Noted. We'll fast-track a credit once backfill completes and we confirm the corrected totals. I'll follow up in this thread and DM with the billing reference. :thumbsup:

Dave (Customer): Appreciate it, thanks everyone.
